text:
claire (ae): FYI Prospect: Northbridge wants POC next Tue but procurement insists on notarized MSA + PO before any data. Any fast paths?
rick (sales-eng): POC pricing is ok. Two main asks: notarization and an HSM attestation. We usually give an attestation letter for POCs.
nina (legal): We should avoid full notarization precedent. Offer two execution options: (1) electronically notarized signature (DocuSign/eID), or (2) physical notarization where customer provides a scanned notarization certificate at signing and mails the original within 30 days. Limit notary to customer's signing exec.
kevin (finance): Our standard is net30. If they require net45 for POC, we need PO + AR approval before provisioning. If they send PO referencing the Order Form with net30 we'll fast-track.
claire (ae): Can we add a one-line POC addendum that locks scope/price and sets provisioning conditions (signed MSA + PO or e-notary)?
nina (legal): Yes. Draft suggestion:
```
POC Addendum: Vendor will provision POC (sandbox) upon execution of the Order Form and either (a) an electronically notarized signature or (b) receipt of a scanned notarization certificate of Customer's authorized executive with the original delivered to Vendor within thirty (30) days. Provisioning is also contingent on receipt of a purchase order referencing the Order Form.
```
rick (sales-eng): Also counter their DPA subprocessor redline. They want prior consent for each subprocessor; propose notice + 30-day objection window and escalation if unresolved.
nina (legal): Agreed. Counter text for subprocessors: Vendor will provide notice of new subprocessors and Customer will have thirty (30) days to object on reasonable data-protection grounds; unresolved objections escalate to good-faith discussions and Customer may temporarily suspend transfers pending resolution.
claire (ae): I'll send tracked changes and ask procurement whether they'd accept scanned notary + mailed original.
esign-bot: :page_facing_up: Envelope e3f1 created (Northbridge_MSA_redline.pdf, OrderForm_POC_NB.pdf). Status: awaiting customer signature.
kevin (finance): If PO comes in with net30 and references the orderform, finance will approve provisioning immediately after MSA executes. If net45, provisioning paused until AR sign-off.
rick (sales-eng): I'll DM procurement to confirm signer name and billing contact.
claire (ae): Prospect replied: "We prefer physical notary but can send a scanned certificate first and try to get PO this week." I'll update when PO or signed envelope arrives.
